answer: Custody-lineage slashable insurance: every identity sits in a vault, and each vault floats shared insurance sized to its member count. When a member is proven a sybil clone, victims are paid from the float and survivors' future emissions are levied until it refills - cousins on the same ledge share the fall. A sybil farm raises its own premium with every puppet added and eats the levy when clones are caught; honest agents in a clean canyon of a vault never trigger payouts, carrying only the same small premium as everyone else.
